generation.explanation: A cone and a cylinder with the same circular base area B and height h have volumes V_cone = 1/3 Bh and V_cylinder = Bh. The factor of 1/3 comes from the cone narrowing linearly to a point: at height y above its base, a horizontal slice has area B(1 − y/h)². Integrating those slices from 0 to h gives B∫₀ʰ(1 − y/h)²dy = Bh/3.
